status: UI artwork and browser interaction reference; production Unity bindings remain to be implemented and tested by the code owner
authority: Game rule layer owns item transfers, timers, score, order completion and save data; UI only sends intents and renders snapshots

scope.collection_key_rule: sort two distinct stable character IDs lexicographically, join with underscore

hud_placement.work_progress: near the relevant station or dry slot
hud_placement.transient_feedback: near the source; expire without hiding critical HUD

layout.scaling: anchor edge panels; adapt spacing and font sizes to viewport, do not stretch the game-camera image to a different aspect ratio
layout.nine_slice_metadata: assets/manifest.json is the authority for each texture's pixel dimensions, transparent padding and slice insets

theme.feedback: text and distinct shape accompany color; no red-green-only status
theme.type: Chinese serif for titles, clear Chinese sans serif for numeric HUD and controls; font binary licensing is a separate integration responsibility

input.focus: opening a modal moves focus into it; closing restores prior focus; modal input must not reach gameplay

selection.conflict: boolean; retain both selections and explain conflict

save.message: localized detail, no success message on failure

rules.pause: freeze round, manual work, both drying slots and all gameplay progression
rules.timeout: disable interactions before accepting a delivery; settle each roundId once
rules.restart: clear hands, stations, progress, order progress and round scores; preserve committed progress/settings
rules.collection_unlock: only at formal round settlement when deliveredSheets>=1; zero stars still qualifies; tutorial and abandoned round never unlock
rules.tutorial_to_round: clear tutorial items and progress; reset score, order sequence, spawn state and 180 seconds
rules.unique_item_transfer: only authoritative successful transfer changes held item, station state, order or score

production_acceptance_scenarios.expect: only first level playable, two distinct confirmed characters required, conflict does not auto-change either player's choice

production_acceptance_scenarios.given: tutorial sheet delivered or Enter pressed
production_acceptance_scenarios.expect: 180 seconds, zero score, first order, empty hands/stations and no tutorial progression remains

production_acceptance_scenarios.given: one held item or occupied target
production_acceptance_scenarios.expect: retain original item, show specific textual reason and never display duplicated held paper

production_acceptance_scenarios.given: dry slots A and B at different progress
production_acceptance_scenarios.expect: round clock and both dry progresses unchanged; resume continues each independently

production_acceptance_scenarios.when: deliver three valid red sheets then settle
production_acceptance_scenarios.expect: 3 sheets, 2 completed orders, 50 points, 1 star; current third order has received 1 of 2 before settlement

production_acceptance_scenarios.given: one formal delivery and fewer than two completed orders
production_acceptance_scenarios.expect: zero stars but first combination collected once

production_acceptance_scenarios.given: tutorial delivery or uncommitted formal delivery
production_acceptance_scenarios.expect: no new collection and no half-round score saved

production_acceptance_scenarios.when: swap P1/P2 characters and finish another round
production_acceptance_scenarios.expect: same sorted combination key, collection count unchanged, best score and stars updated independently
readable text, focus and hit targets, no clipped critical numbers, no permanent central panel hiding workstations
return to pause without advancing gameplay; controls actually affect their documented target

production_acceptance_scenarios.given: timer reaches zero on delivery frame
production_acceptance_scenarios.when: delivery or result callback is repeated
production_acceptance_scenarios.expect: no late score and exactly one result/save operation

production_acceptance_scenarios.given: save write failure or corrupted saved data
production_acceptance_scenarios.expect: visible failure or recovery notice; preserve recoverable backup; no false saved label

validation_boundary: These are Unity integration targets and acceptance cases, not a claim that this asset repository contains a tested Unity project. Browser preview behavior and test evidence must be reported separately.
